### What types of home care does BrightStar Care® of Westfield & Summit offer?
BrightStar Care of Westfield & Summit provides personalized home care for seniors, adults, children and families throughout Union County, NJ. Our services include:

What makes our local agency different is the range and flexibility of care we can provide. A family may need just a few hours of companionship or personal care today and more advanced support later. Because we offer both non-medical and skilled care with RN oversight, families can often continue working with one trusted local team even as their loved ones’ needs change.
Call our Westfield office at 908.322.8200, and we’ll help you determine what level of care makes sense for your family.

We understand that the need for home care doesn't always come with weeks of notice. A hospital discharge, fall, surgery, or sudden change in a parent's condition can leave a family needing help quickly. Call 908.322.8200 to speak directly with our local team about your needs.
### Do you offer 24-hour and live-in home care in Union County, NJ?

Yes, BrightStar Care of Westfield & Summit offers a wide range of home care options for families who need significant support at home, including extended shifts, overnight care, live-in care, and around-the-clock care (also known 24-hour care).
